provenance.icd10: Canonical URI taken from the FHIR R4 specification, hl7.org/fhir/R4/icd.html. Codes and displays checked against the ICD-10 release published by tx.fhir.org.
provenance.orphanet: Canonical URI and OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12559.11.10.1.3.1.44.5 taken from the HL7 Terminology external code system registry. Note the https scheme, which the registry gives and which is case sensitive. ORPHAcodes and preferred terms checked against ORDO, the Orphanet ontology, through the EBI Ontology Lookup Service.
provenance.loinc: Canonical URI taken from the FHIR R4 specification. Codes and long common names checked against LOINC 2.82 through tx.fhir.org. LOINC part codes, which start with LP, are deliberately not used: they name concepts but are not observable codes.
provenance.ucum: Canonical URI taken from the FHIR R4 specification. Every unit below was validated with a $validate-code call against tx.fhir.org.
provenance.legacy: example.org is reserved for documentation, which makes it the honest choice for a code system that only exists inside this synthetic project.
provenance.orphanetCodeFormat: ORPHAcodes are written here as bare numbers, such as 324, because the ORPHAcode is defined as a number and the system URI already says which nomenclature it belongs to. Some implementations write ORPHA:324 instead. The HL7 registry does not state which form is expected.

LB-GBA.unmappedReason: LOINC 2.82 has no quantitative code for beta-glucosidase activity: the only matches are interpretation codes for the activator protein. The local code is kept on its own rather than forced onto a code that means something else.
